on_record.label: Source: this record.
on_record.explanation: The contributing value or values come from this record. This describes their source, not their evidence grade.

inherited_from_parent.label: Source: includes inheritance from a parent record.
inherited_from_parent.explanation: At least one contributing value is inherited from a parent record. Other contributing values may come from this record. Inheritance does not reduce the evidence grade.
